text: Zoho or Microsoft Dynamics 365? It's not two CRM screens.
Zoho One is a bundle. Dozens of apps, one licence per user.
Dynamics 365 is a family of separate products, each with its own plans.
Need two of them? You hold a base licence, then an attach licence.
Forecasting and custom records start at Zoho CRM Standard. On Microsoft, at Sales Enterprise.
For ERP, Microsoft goes deeper. Business Central Premium includes manufacturing.
And agents? Both charge for heavy use in credits.
So list people by role. Then find the plan where each feature starts.
Read the full comparison at zudoworks.com
